I also could not find support contact information within the app. Please: * Cancel all subscriptions associated with these purchases and disable automatic renewal. * Refund both charges, totaling $59.98, to their original payment methods. * Confirm the cancellations and refunds in writing, including the expected processing time. Thank you for your prompt attention and resolution.

title: I highly recommend it!!
body: I absolutely love the Sacred Bible app. It’s simple, beautifully designed, and makes it easy to stay connected with God’s Word every day. The interface is clean, the features are helpful without being overwhelming, and it truly enhances my daily reading and reflection.

title: A breath of Fresh Air in a Digital World
body: As someone who spends most of the day jumping between code and documentation, finding a moment of peace can be a challenge. This app has become a cornerstone of my morning routine. The UI is incredible clean,and the daily Devotion and Prayer content isn’t just “fluff”-it’s actually thought-provoking and grounded in scripture. I specially love how well it integrates with the iOS ecosystem. It doesn’t feel like another notification to clear, but rather a meaningful invitation to pause. Truly a 5-star experience for any modern believer.

title: Finally, a faith app with premium experience!
body: As someone who appreciates clean design and smooth performance, I am beyond impressed. Most religious apps feel outdated, but this one is sleek, fast, and intuitive.

title: A Daily Source of Peace and Encouragement
body: This app has become an essential part of my morning routine. The daily devotionals are deeply rooted in Scripture and provide the he perfect amount of encouragement to stat my day with a clear mind and peacefully heart. The interfaces is clean and easy to navigate, making it simple to stay consistent in my walk with God. Truly a blessing!
